gaps: us_lav_lav_25a2: no photo straight from the rear or above; the rear and top views are Mick Bell's 1987 drawings of the base LAV-25, before the A2's applique armour, raised suspension and newer sight.
us_lav_lav_25a2: A2 identification is by date (USMC photos after about 2010), not by a visible marker.
us_lav_lav_at: no three_quarter_rear or rear photo; the rear elevation and top plan come from Mick Bell's 1987 drawing.
us_lav_lav_at: the side photo is a black-and-white 1990 early vehicle; colour hull side shown only in the right front detail.
us_lav_lav_at: the LAV-ATM (2010s replacement turret) is a different vehicle and was excluded.
us_lav_lav_at: no close-up of the Emerson hammerhead launcher or its sight; photos of the 2014 modernised turret (ATWS) were excluded as a different launcher.
